scenarios.title: Investment Choice
scenarios.description: You have $1,000 to invest. You can choose between two investment options with the same expected return but different risk profiles.

choices.title: Safe Investment
choices.details: You will definitely receive $200 profit, ending with $1,200 total.

choices.title: Risky Investment
choices.description: 50% chance to gain $400, 50% chance to gain $0
choices.details: Coin flip: heads you gain $400, tails you gain nothing.

scenarios.title: Financial Emergency
scenarios.description: You face an unexpected expense and must choose how to handle a $1,000 loss. You have two options to minimize the damage.

choices.title: Accept Certain Loss
choices.details: You will definitely lose $300, leaving you $700 short of where you started.

choices.title: Take a Gamble
choices.description: 50% chance to lose $600, 50% chance to lose $0
choices.details: Coin flip: heads you lose $600, tails you lose nothing.

scenarios.title: Business Opportunity
scenarios.description: You're considering a business opportunity that requires an upfront investment. You can choose between a conservative approach or a more aggressive strategy.

choices.title: Conservative Strategy
choices.details: Steady, predictable returns with minimal risk of loss.

choices.title: Aggressive Strategy
choices.description: 60% chance to gain $1,000, 40% chance to lose $250
choices.details: Higher potential returns but with substantial risk of loss.

classic_pattern.description: Risk-averse in gains domain, risk-seeking in losses domain

high.description: High loss aversion - strong tendency to avoid losses even when taking greater risks

moderate.description: Moderate loss aversion - some sensitivity to framing effects

low.description: Low loss aversion - relatively consistent risk preferences across domains

instructions: This assessment measures your tendency toward loss aversion - the psychological principle that losses feel worse than equivalent gains. For each scenario, choose the option you would prefer, considering the risks and potential outcomes.
